content.title: What Rory McIlroy and Wife Erica Stoll Said About Calling off Divorce
content.text: Rory McIlroy and wife Erica Stoll’s marriage has been in the public eye over the past year. Back in May 2024, news broke that McIlroy had filed for divorce from Stoll. The couple has been married since 2017. Despite speculation about the future of the couple’s relationship, McIlroy and Stoll had a change of heart. All indications are that McIlroy and his wife remain married. McIlroy released a statement on June 11, 2024, on behalf of the couple, emphasizing that they had “resolved our differences.” “There have been rumors about my personal life recently, which is unfortunate,” McIlroy told The Guardian. “Responding to each rumor is a fool’s game. Rory McIlroy celebrates his win with then-girlfriend Erica Stoll after the Tour Championship at East Lake Golf Club.Brett Davis-Imagn Images “Over the past weeks, Erica and I have realized that our best future was as a family together,” McIlroy continued. “Thankfully, we have resolved our differences and look forward to a new beginning.” Back in November, McIlroy posted a photo on Instagram of Stoll and their daughter, Poppy, joining him on the golf course after winning the DP World Tour Championship. McIlroy recently revealed that his wife wants to spend more time in England. “If it was up to her, she wouldn’t move to England straightaway but she definitely wants to spend more time there,” McIlroy said, per The New York Post’s Jaclyn Hendricks. ESPN’s Mark Schlabach reported on June 11, that an attorney representing McIlory had “filed a motion Tuesday to voluntarily dismiss a divorce petition that was filed on the golfer’s behalf in a Florida court last month.” This page may contain affiliate links to legal sports betting or fantasy sports partners.
